coastal.title: B.C. man who went missing in mountains for several days found alive
coastal.description: Stanislav Volo went for a hike on Sunday above the Sea-to-Sky Gondola and did not return home.

coastal.title: Province advances Old Fort landslide study in northeast B.C.
coastal.description: Three separate landslides in the same spot since 2018 have prompted evacuations and destroyed a home and other critical infrastructure in the Old Fort community just south of Fort St John.

coastal.title: Friend holds out hope for Canadian runner missing on Matterhorn
coastal.description: A friend of a Canadian athlete who went missing on the Matterhorn says Squamish, B.C.'s mountain running community is hoping for her safe return.

kamloops.title: After an intense summer of wildfires, Lytton River Festival aims to bring life to the community
kamloops.description: The Village of Lytton is hosting its annual festival this year, with a special emphasis on cultural history of Chinese people and the village's legacy.

prince-george.title: Northern B.C. community brings back dinosaur mascot from extinction, after a nearly 30-year 'sabbatical'
prince-george.description: The District of Hudson's Hope unveiled a new costume for the town's mascot, Dudley the Dinosaur, last week. Kelsey Shewfelt, the recreation co-ordinator for the district, says the public has been asking to see Dudley return for years.

prince-george.title: Critic calls on B.C. to salvage more wildfire-burned timber, province says that's 'unrealistic.' Here's why
prince-george.description: Kamloops-North Thompson MLA Ward Stamer is calling for the province’s salvage rate to rise to 25 per cent and for more efficient access to wildfire-damaged timber.

prince-george.title: Brink Forest Products to cut 50 jobs at its Prince George lumber plant
prince-george.description: Brink Forest Products cuts roughly 50 jobs at its Prince George, B.C., plant as the company reduces operations to 20 per cent citing a lack of fibre and U.S. tariff costs, among factors.
